findings.description: Saving a new expense once (a single POST /expenses) creates two identical rows, so the list shows a duplicate and the total is inflated by the amount twice. The duplicate persists after reload.
repro: Enter title 'QA test item', amount 10.10, category office, click Save expense once
Observe two 'QA test item' rows (ids 9 and 10) and total rising by 20.20 instead of 10.10; reload and both remain

findings.description: When a category filter is applied, the listed rows are filtered but the Total still shows the sum of all expenses (e.g. $399.99 with only the 3 travel rows, which sum to $185.25), so the total does not equal the sum of the listed amounts.
repro: Choose category travel and click Apply

notes: Edit flow (list and total update immediately), viewer read-only (no controls, 403 on direct edit/new/delete/POST) and unauthenticated redirects worked. Extreme amounts (99999999999) and 0 are accepted without limit; not reported.

cost.notes: estimate from 25294 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0051-$0.0607
